Prezi pioneered the zooming canvas for presentations and remains the market leader in that space. It recently added AI-powered generation and text editing tools. We show how to configure an agent that understands your organization’s processes, connects to your HR systems, and automates common tasks, such as answering new-hire questions and tracking document completion.

items.title: Accelerate agentic tool calling with serverless model customization in Amazon SageMaker AI
items.raw_excerpt: In this post, we walk through how we fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct for tool calling using RLVR. We cover dataset preparation across three distinct agent behaviors, reward function design with tiered scoring, training configuration and results interpretation, evaluation on held-out data with unseen tools, and deployment.

items.title: Building Intelligent Search with Amazon Bedrock and Amazon OpenSearch for hybrid RAG solutions
items.raw_excerpt: In this post, we show how to implement a generative AI agentic assistant that uses both semantic and text-based search using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents and Amazon OpenSearch.

title_i18n.zh: 利用亚马逊Bedrock与亚马逊OpenSearch构建混合RAG解决方案的智能搜索系统

excerpt_i18n.en: In this post, we show how to implement a generative AI agentic assistant that uses both semantic and text-based search using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents and Amazon OpenSearch.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 本文展示如何利用Amazon Bedrock、Amazon Bedrock AgentCore、Strands Agents及Amazon OpenSearch，实现一个结合语义与文本搜索的生成式AI智能助手。
excerpt_i18n.es: En esta publicación, mostramos cómo implementar un asistente de IA generativa agéntico que utiliza búsqueda tanto semántica como basada en texto empleando Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents y Amazon OpenSearch.

items.title: From isolated alerts to contextual intelligence: Agentic maritime anomaly analysis with generative AI
items.raw_excerpt: This blog post demonstrates how Windward helps enhance and accelerate alert investigation processes by combining geospatial intelligence with generative AI, enabling analysts to focus on decision-making rather than data collection.

title_i18n.en: From isolated alerts to contextual intelligence: Agentic maritime anomaly analysis with generative AI
title_i18n.zh: 从孤立警报到情境智能：利用生成式人工智能实现自主海事异常分析。
title_i18n.es: De alertas aisladas a inteligencia contextual: análisis de anomalías marítimas con IA generativa de tipo agente

excerpt_i18n.en: This blog post demonstrates how Windward helps enhance and accelerate alert investigation processes by combining geospatial intelligence with generative AI, enabling analysts to focus on decision-making rather than data collection.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 这篇博客展示了Windward如何通过结合地理空间智能与生成式人工智能，来增强并加速警报调查流程，使分析师能专注于决策而非数据处理。
excerpt_i18n.es: Esta entrada de blog muestra cómo Windward ayuda a mejorar y acelerar los procesos de investigación de alertas al combinar inteligencia geoespacial con IA generativa, permitiendo que los analistas se centren en la toma de decisiones en lugar de en los datos.
